description: What a JSON-RPC method takes, and whether this key can actually call it on this chain. Returns the positional param shape and a worked example for every method rpcCall can validate, plus rpcCall's own verdict (permitted, or refused as a write path). Pass probe:true with an explicit methods list (max 12) to also ask the node, so served reflects your key, your tenant and the chain's blockchain schema instead of a guess: yes, no, restricted, or unknown. A refused method is never sent. Without methods it returns the whole catalogue and does not probe. The catalogue is SHAPE guidance, not a coverage list: a method missing from it may still be served, and the chain's schema is the authority.

chain.description: Chain slug as in rpc.ankr.com/<chain> — any chain Ankr serves (see listChains)

methods.description: Methods to describe (max 12); omit for the whole catalogue

items.description: JSON-RPC method, e.g. eth_call, eth_estimateGas, Filecoin.ChainHead

probe.description: Ask the node whether each method is served (needs methods)

name: describeMethods
title: Describe JSON-RPC method shapes and availability
